definitions.explanation: A feeling of astonishment at something extraordinary, or something that inspires such astonishment. Emphasizes awe and admiration rather than fear.

examples.japanese: {驚異的|きょういてき}な⟦スピード→スピード：11048_supiido⟧だ。
⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{驚異|きょうい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見張|みは}った→見張る：18224_miharu⟧。
examples.english: I marveled at the wonders of nature.

examples.japanese: ⟦{科学|かがく}→科学：01277_kagaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{進歩|しんぽ}→進歩：03265_shinpo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{驚異|きょうい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えて→与える：01821_ataeru⟧きた。
examples.english: Scientific progress has given people wonder and hope.

notes:
{驚異|きょうい} expresses a sense of wonder and astonishment at something extraordinary. The nuance is positive — awe and admiration rather than fear.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {驚異的|きょういてき}な: astonishing, phenomenal (na-adjective form)
- ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{驚異|きょうい}: wonders of nature
- {驚異|きょうい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧: an astonishing record
- {驚異|きょうい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{満|み}ちた→満ちる：02428_michiru⟧: filled with wonder

WATCH OUT:
- {驚異|きょうい}: wonder, marvel (positive)
- ⟦{脅威|きょうい}→脅威：13932_kyoui⟧: threat, menace (negative)
The kanji {驚|きょう} (surprise) vs. {脅|きょう} (threaten) distinguishes them.

REGISTER:
Somewhat formal and literary. In casual speech, ⟦すごい→すごい：01128_sugoi⟧ or ⟦{驚|おどろ}く→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧べき are more common.
